name: How do I know if my bathroom remodel estimate is too low?

mainEntity.name: What warning signs indicate a bathroom remodeling bid may be unrealistically cheap?
mainEntity.text: What warning signs indicate a bathroom remodeling bid may be unrealistically cheap?

acceptedAnswer.text: An unusually low estimate is not always a bargain. It may mean the contractor has left out key items such as waterproofing, haul-away, tile setting labor, electrical work, finish trim, or permit handling. Another warning sign is vague language about allowances that do not match the quality level the homeowner expects. If one proposal is much lower than the others, ask exactly what is missing and whether the price includes hidden-damage contingencies. The safest bid is usually the one that is detailed, transparent, and realistic about the job’s complexity. A low estimate can become expensive if it leads to constant add-ons and disputes after construction starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: A bid may be too low if it lacks detail, omits waterproofing or permits, uses vague allowances, or promises a very fast schedule for a complex job. Extremely low estimates often lead to change orders once the work starts.
